node_prereqs_main.title: Prerequisites & Docs
node_prereqs_main.chatText: Expand to see all requirements and documents needed before starting.

step_1.title: Step 1
step_1.chatText: Step 1: Book an appointment for a driving test or license application at the RTO office in Mumbai. You can do this online or by visiting the office in person.

step_2.title: Step 2
step_2.chatText: Step 2: Fill out the Driving License Application Form and attach the required documents (Proof of Identity, Proof of Address, and Recent Passport-sized Photographs).

step_3.title: Step 3
step_3.chatText: Step 3: Submit the application form and required documents to the RTO office during your scheduled appointment.

step_4.title: Step 4
step_4.chatText: Step 4: Take the driving test (if applicable) and pass it to obtain your driving license.

step_5.title: Step 5
step_5.chatText: Step 5: Collect your driving license from the RTO office once it is processed.
